title: Negative-Depth Character Extension
body_html:
Negative-Depth Character Extension

Let \(G_L\) be a twisted Levi subgroup of \(G\) with \(Z({}^{\circ}G_L)/Z(G_L)\) anisotropic. Let \(\Gamma\) be a negative-depth element in the center of \(\operatorname{Lie}(G_L)\), and let \(x\in B(G_L)\). Then there is a character \[ \phi:G_{L,x}\to\mathbb C^\times \] such that for \(g\in G_{L,x,0+}\), \[ \phi(g)=\psi(B(\Gamma,\operatorname{log} g)). \]
proof_html: The anisotropic-center hypothesis excludes the \(O(1,1)\) and general linear factors in the center of \(G_L\). Thus the relevant central Lie algebra lies in a product of unitary Lie algebra factors. Kim's connected-group character extension result supplies the character on each factor, and their product gives the required \(\phi\).
